scope: finite 2-client capacity test for exact native without aggregation under 2.85GB ClickHouse server memory cap
protocol: Four fresh-server phases R35/R38/R38/R35; four synchronized two-client waves each, including two warmup waves and two measured waves per phase. Every successful HTTP native query_range response passed the full independent generator-derived oracle. Every attempt, including failures and warmups, recorded. Server RSS sampled 50ms; sampled RSS not a guaranteed process maximum.

r35.all_failure_kind: total-memory-limit-exceeded, OvercommitTracker selected query to stop

results.success_oracle: PASS for all successful requests; full 532 label/time/value points; no successful-output mismatch

negative_scope: This is not an OOM kill by the kernel.
Finite stress matrix, not general safe concurrency, p95/p99 or production SLA.
No read/write/merge, retention, multi-tenant ACL, sharding or optimized VictoriaMetrics parity tested.
Memory tracker max and sampled RSS are distinct; RSS sampling may miss peaks.

raw_archive.contains: all 32 synchronized request outcomes, errors, exact semantic oracle harness, server sampled RSS waves, phase reports, part census

next_gate: Sustained open-loop mixed selectors with concurrent small remote_write ingest, merges and retention under same 4CPU/4GiB/2.85GB constraints, including non-2-client error and queue-delay tails
